summary: Intercure Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, solely to remind shareholders of voting procedures for an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for August 11, 2026. The filing details voting methods, record date of July 29, 2026, and proxy card availability. No special-situation transaction is announced. This is a routine meeting notice equivalent to a US proxy circular. There is no deal, stake change, or strategic event described. The filing is procedural, with no board recommendation or transaction terms.
